policy_title: Church Street Approved Height Selection Policy
description: Multi-tier height evidence assignment separating Google ML estimates, source floor counts, and commercial canyon defaults.
scientific_qualification: The Church Street scene has been converted into an exploratory local-coordinate triangular-mesh representation using approved but partly uncertain building-height estimates.

summary.scientific_framing: The Church Street scene has been converted into an exploratory local-coordinate triangular-mesh representation using approved but partly uncertain building-height estimates.

axis_1_decision_status.purpose: Formal gate determining whether building height is approved/accepted for simulation or marked uncertain

axis_2_uncertainty_tier.purpose: Evidence quality rating based on source corroboration and pixel coverage

sensitivity_cohort_definition.description: The 40 buildings represents the union of High Uncertainty (29) + Extreme Uncertainty (11) tiers. This cohort comprises all 16 Uncertain status buildings plus 24 Approved/Accepted buildings with high uncertainty (2 core floor fallbacks lacking ML + 22 context ML estimates with <50% pixel coverage).

fallback_parameters.rationale: 3 commercial floors x 3.2m typical Church Street commercial canyon height
